purpose: The dungeon kit (#10089): a modular dungeon's building drawn from these pieces, fitted to its cells by DungeonKit. The language is the ancients' (docs/style-references/ancients: Whim's vocabulary, Bones' ruin state; the kit sheet is asset-pipeline live-evidence/dungeon-kit-20261020/kit-sheet.png). Each piece is a prop mesh in one cell's frame: origin at the cell's centre in plan and at the bottom of its floor block; the room is 6 m across (walls 1 m thick at the cell's edge), the floor top at 1 m, the ceiling from 5 m; a wall stands on the cell's south edge (-z) and a corner in its south-west. Authored in Blender for exact geometry (kit_authored.py), painted from its geometry (kit_paint.py: calm bone stone with sparse bold cracks, teal ceramic mosaic, dull brass) and reduced as pixel art at 32 texels/m.
